title: PARAMO Ecuador Results Explorer: Planning And Resource Allocation under Multi-scenario Optimization
description: Interactive public explorer for long-term Ecuador power-system planning results generated with PARAMO. Version 2.5.0 rebuilds the national 24-bus representative trajectories using robust_multimetric selection, adds aggregate transmission-investment and hydro-seasonality views, and displays the mainland Ecuador boundary with only the existing 230/500 kV grid plus independently switchable reduced networks.
